description: An offline empty state with a retry action that reconnects and reveals a grid of albums.
overview: An offline state for a content app, with a Wi-Fi icon, an explanation and Try Again and Downloads buttons. Try Again shows a spinner while reconnecting, then reveals an album grid. Use it as the no-connection screen for media, feeds or any app that can fall back to cached content.
usage: Replace `albums` with your content. The demo fakes reconnecting with a timer; drive the offline, loading and online states from your network status or a refetch instead, and remove the Disconnect link from the online view. Give the Downloads button a handler.
notes: Album artwork is an Unsplash placeholder.
